displayName: Peptide Canva Marketing Pack — Flyers, Catalog & Labels
description: Flagship Canva suite for peptide programs: education flyers, a multi-page therapy catalog, and editable vial-style labels. Each item opens as your own copy in Canva — add branding, pricing, and compliant copy with your medical director and counsel. Instant digital delivery; nothing ships.
targetBuyer: Med spas and wellness clinics offering peptide therapy who want Etsy-style editable marketing without hiring a designer for every asset

templates.name: Peptide education flyers (Canva)
templates.description: Multiple patient-facing flyer layouts — comparisons, benefits, anti-aging themes. Edit in Canva; export PDF or PNG.

templates.name: Peptide therapy catalog (Canva)
templates.description: Multi-page catalog structure for benefits, applications, and your pricing — logo and QR placeholders.

templates.name: Peptide vial labels (Canva)
templates.description: Editable label frames with brand placeholders — confirm print specs with your label vendor before production.

deliveryNote: Three delivery links: each hub page contains a button wired to a Canva URL you set in the HTML (CANVA_EDIT_URL). Replace placeholder links before launch or update after deploy. Medical/legal review recommended for all patient- and product-facing copy.
